adjudication.rationale: In `SalesforceCalendarService`, refreshed tokens are parsed via `parseRefreshTokenResponse(accessTokenJson, salesforceTokenSchema)` and then persisted as `{ ...accessTokenParsed.data, refresh_token: credentialKey.refresh_token }`. However, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts). That minimum schema does not include `instance_url`, so Zod will drop it from `data` when parsing, causing the persisted credential key to lose `instance_url`. `jsforce.Connection` relies on `instanceUrl/instance_url`, so this can break subsequent usage of the refreshed/synced credential.
